invariants.text: Order.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An order in the cancelled state cannot transition to the shipped state.
An order in the shipped state cannot transition to the cancelled state.
An order must start in the pending state.
An order can transition from pending to confirmed.
An order can transition from pending to shipped.
An order can transition from pending to cancelled.
An order can transition from confirmed to shipped.
An order can transition from confirmed to cancelled.
An order can transition from shipped to cancelled.
Once an order is shipped, it cannot be moved back to pending or confirmed.
